当前媒体还没有可下载的字幕，请先打开原生字幕或请求 AI 字幕: No downloadable subtitles yet. Enable native captions or generate AI subtitles first.
当前浏览器无法完整采集媒体音频，请使用桌面版 Edge 或 Chrome: This browser cannot capture media audio. Use desktop Edge or Chrome.
当前媒体没有可复制的音频源: This media has no audio source that can be copied.
当前媒体没有可捕获的音轨: This media has no audio track that can be captured.
播放采集需要 HTTPS 或本地页面及支持 AudioWorklet 的浏览器: Playback capture requires HTTPS or a local page and a browser with AudioWorklet support.
实时本地字幕需要 1 倍速播放，请调整倍速后重试: Live local captions require 1× playback. Change the speed and retry.
当前媒体没有可读取的音轨，请先播放后重试；受保护媒体无法生成本地字幕: No readable audio track. Start playback and retry; protected media cannot generate local captions.
本地识别速度跟不上播放，已停止以保护浏览器性能，请暂停后重试: Local recognition cannot keep up with playback. Capture stopped to protect performance. Pause and retry.
媒体位置或倍速已改变，请重新开始本地字幕: Playback position or speed changed. Restart local captions.
video.description: Translate captions in videos and web meetings. No audio or video is uploaded.
video.learning.title: Sentence learning
video.learning.cueEnvelope: Playback uses the original subtitle range; word-level timing is unavailable.
video.learning.hint: In the player: ← / → change sentence, R loops, Q pauses at the end. Esc exits fullscreen or closes learning outside fullscreen. Choose assistance, then replay to start; seeking manually releases assistance. Drag the title to move the panel. Editing pins the sentence and keeps your drafts.
video.learning.empty: No timeline yet. Enable original video captions and retry after loading.
video.learning.playFailed: Playback blocked. Use the video play button.
video.learning.enableExplain: Enable AI explanations in selection translation settings first.
video.learning.saved: Saved to the learning center. Repeated saves merge.
video.learning.tooLong: This caption or explanation is too long to save. Shorten the explanation to 2,000 characters; saved source text allows up to 4,096 characters.
video.learning.stopped: Explanation stopped. Edit it or generate it again.
video.learning.drag: Drag the title to move the panel; use the arrow to move it outside the video
video.localMedia.title: Local audio & video transcription
video.localMedia.description: Import a local audio or video file to decode locally and generate bilingual subtitles with Whisper or Local Qwen3 ASR.
video.localMedia.unsupportedBrowser: Local media transcription is unavailable in this environment. Use the desktop browser extension.
video.localMedia.dropHint: Drop an audio or video file here, or click to choose one
video.localMedia.formatsHint: Supports MP4 / WebM / MP3 / M4A / WAV / OGG / FLAC (up to 200 MB and 20 minutes)
video.localMedia.errorEmpty: The selected media file is empty. Choose a valid file.
video.localMedia.errorTooLarge: The file exceeds the 200 MB limit. Trim or compress it first.
video.localMedia.errorUnsupported: Unsupported format. Choose MP4, WebM, MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, or FLAC.
